svg.title: Plate PL-03 — The Scale Ladder: Quark to Galaxy
svg.desc: A vertical engraved plate. A logarithmic axis of characteristic length from 10 to the minus 16 to 10 to the 21 metres carries sixteen rungs from encyclopedia chapter NA-10, from the proton charge radius to the Milky Way isophotal diameter. Each rung lists characteristic length, time and energy, dominant force, governing dimensionless group, and whether a Markov blanket is identifiable. Regime boundaries are marked only where NA-10 names them. Fenced MODELED; no UNI claims.

g.text: UNI ENCYCLOPEDIA · WING NATURA · SOURCE NA-10
The Scale Ladder: Quark to Galaxy

REGIME BOUNDARY · DOMINANT FORCE CHANGES IDENTITY: STRONG → ELECTROMAGNETIC
REGIME BOUNDARY · DIFFUSION → CONVECTION (NA-10 detection test 2)
REGIME BOUNDARY · EM → GRAVITY (gravity enters at rung 10; leads from rung 13)
FIGURE KEY
point — a measured or adopted single value
(rungs 1, 2, 4, 13, 14, 15: radii or defined lengths)
open point — D25 isophotal diameter (rung 16):
a brightness convention (B-band 25 mag/arcsec²), not a geometric extent
extent bar — a rung range (rungs 5–12). This is the
chapter's CARVING: a choice fenced MODELED, not a measurement
dashed mark / † — NOT-SOURCED in NA-10's own pass
† is NOT NOT-MEASURED, and the two are never merged (NA-00):
NOT-MEASURED = nature has not been asked — a fact about the world's
knowledge. NOT-SOURCED = we cannot say who asked — a fact about this
corpus's own homework. This plate marks † only where NA-10 marks itself;
an unmarked cell is not thereby sourced.
BLANKET GLYPHS (NA-04 typing; is a Markov blanket identifiable?)
Yes
Marginal
Contested
No
accent band — a regime boundary NAMED BY NA-10 (not inferred here)
SI prefixes on the axis are DEFINITIONAL (BIPM), not measurements.
Classes on this plate — NATURA twelve-value vocabulary (NA-00, as amended
2026-07-15-A): OBSERVED-REPLICATED · OBSERVED-CONTESTED · MODELED ·
NOT-MEASURED · NOT-SOURCED. A NATURA class is NEVER a UNI gate.
WHERE THE POWER LAW BREAKS — THE RECEIPT
DeLong, Okie, Moses, Sibly & Brown (2010), PNAS 107(29):12941–5.
B ∝ M^b fitted across ~16 orders of magnitude in BODY MASS,
split at the major evolutionary transitions:
Prokaryotes superlinear
Protists linear
Metazoans sublinear
Their explicit conclusion: Kleiber's 3/4-power law DOES NOT APPLY
universally across organisms (NA10-24). The exponent does not drift —
it changes curvature relative to linear, exactly at the transitions.
That is a rung boundary showing up in the residuals.
These breaks were fitted against MASS, not length. They have
NO position on this plate's L axis, and are shown apart on purpose
rather than placed at a length nobody measured.
VISCOUS → INERTIAL (Re ≈ 1) — NA-10's headline boundary,
the death of the scallop theorem. It lies INSIDE the rungs 7–10
domain and has NO single L: Re = vL/ν depends on v. Drawn as a
bracket on the axis, never as a line. Span Re ≈ 10⁻⁵ → 3 × 10⁸,
~10¹³ — ~13 orders, NOT the ~10¹⁰ in circulation (NA10-15,
corrected in-chapter). Re is not defined for an atom or a galaxy.
BEFORE EXTRAPOLATING — RUN ALL FIVE

text.tspan: A power law fitted within a regime does not extrapolate

svg.text: through a regime boundary. Not "less accurately". It does
not carry, and its exponent stops being a fact about the world.
Did the dominant dimensionless group move by orders of
magnitude across the span? (Re: ~13 orders, bacterium → whale.)
Did the dominant force change IDENTITY? (Viscosity → inertia.
Diffusion → convection. EM → gravity.) A change of dominant
term, not of coefficient, is a boundary.
Does the log–log plot have curvature? Fit a quadratic in log-mass
and test the coefficient against zero. Curvature is a power law's
own confession. (NA10-25 — OBSERVED-CONTESTED: carried live on
both sides, settled by neither.)
Does the fitted exponent depend on WHICH SUBSET you fit? Small-
dominated → ~2/3; large-dominated → ~3/4. If so you have a curve,
not a law. (NA10-26 — OBSERVED-CONTESTED.)
Is there an INDEPENDENT structural boundary at the suspected
break? A break located only by scanning residuals is a fitted
artefact until pre-registered. Per M2 the verdict is the CI bound
EXCLUDING the threshold, never the point estimate.
CAPTION
WHAT THIS PLATE DOES NOT CLAIM
THE PLATE. Sixteen rungs from NA-10's ladder table, ordered by
characteristic length L, spanning ~10³⁶ (NA10-40) from the proton rms charge
radius 8.4075(64) × 10⁻¹⁶ m (NA10-01, OBSERVED-REPLICATED, CODATA 2022) to the
Milky Way D25 isophotal diameter ≈8.3 × 10²⁰ m (NA10-37, OBSERVED-CONTESTED;
primary not read in NA-10's pass). The axis carries L and nothing else.
RUNGS OVERLAP IN L. Rungs 8 (tissue, 10⁻⁴–10⁻² m) and 10 (organism,
10⁻³–3 × 10¹ m) both occupy 10⁻³ m. The dominant force is therefore a property of
the RUNG, not of the length — so this axis carries no force band. Read force from
the row, never from a position on the bar.
THE L COLUMN IS NOT ONE MEASURAND. Rungs 1/2/13/14 are radii; rung 16
is a D25 isophotal diameter (a brightness convention); rungs 5–12 are ranges. Per
NA-10: the span is real; the uniformity is approximate. The ladder's top rung is
measured by a different KIND of instrument than its bottom rung.
EXTENT BARS ARE THE CARVING, NOT A MEASUREMENT. NA-10 fences the rung
count and the rung boundaries as a CHOICE, not a discovery: a different carving
(adding virus, biofilm, galaxy cluster) is equally defensible. What is not a choice
is that the dominant force changes identity across the span.
THE t COLUMN MUST NEVER BE REGRESSED. r_p/c (a light-crossing time), a
C–H stretch period (a vibration), a division time (a doubling) and the Sun's nuclear
lifetime (fuel exhaustion) are four different physical measurands in one column. It
is a placement aid. NA-10 records regressing it as a NEGATIVE / conflation trap.
† = NOT-SOURCED IN NA-10'S OWN PASS — the chapter prints the value and
could not trace it to a source: rung 3 L, rung 6 L, rung 7 t, rung 15 heliopause,
rung 16 t, and the groups at rungs 8, 9, 12 (NA10-43/44/45). NA-10 caught these on
its own re-read and named them rather than leave them standing. Their presence is
the evidence that its gate works, not evidence that it failed.
BOUNDARIES ARE MARKED ONLY WHERE NA-10 NAMES THEM. The viscous → inertial
crossing (Re ≈ 1) has NO single L — Re = vL/ν depends on v — so it is a bracket over
rungs 7–10, not a line. The metabolic-exponent breaks were fitted against mass, not
length, and are shown in a separate panel on purpose.
BLANKETS ARE NOT MONOTONE IN L. Identifiable at rung 6 (double membrane,
own genome, own fission), rung 7 (plasma membrane — the canonical case) and rung 10;
absent above and below. Rungs 5, 8, 9 marginal (8 also contested); rung 11 contested
(the superorganism debate). A galaxy is enormous and has no blanket; a mitochondrion
is a micron across and has one. SIZE IS NOT WHAT MAKES A BOUNDARY.
WHAT A RUNG IS, OPERABLY — all three, or you have named a size, not a level:
(a) a boundary with real conditional independence (Markov blanket, NA-04); (b) a new
characteristic timescale separates from the level below (Simon 1962, near-decomposa-
bility); (c) the level has its own dynamics not requiring the level below (Anderson
1972, More Is Different). (b) causes (c). Emergence here is a claim about spectral
gaps in a dynamical system, not about magic.
LEDGER SUPREMACY, APPLIED. Where a chapter and NATURE-LEDGER disagree, the
ledger wins (NA-00). Rung 1's t is printed at the ledger's precision, ~2.8 × 10⁻²⁴ s
(NA10-02, MODELED — computed, and NOT a measured interaction time); NA-10's ladder
cell rounds it to ~3 × 10⁻²⁴ s. Rung 1's energy is sourced across chapters to CN04-25
(BE/A peak = ⁶²Ni at 8.7945 MeV/nucleon — not ⁵⁶Fe, which has the lowest MASS per
nucleon, a different quantity).
NOT a progression, a hierarchy of value, an arrow, or a direction. It is an
ordering BY LENGTH. The blanket column does not ascend with it, and specific power
runs AGAINST it: a bacterium outputs ~5 × 10⁶ times more power per kilogram than the
Sun does (NA10-29, MODELED ÷ MODELED — both endpoints are conversions).
NOT that "information density" or "degree of internal model" increases along the
ladder. NOT-MEASURED — no measurand, no units, no instrument (NA10-41, NA10-42).
This is the gradient the ladder most invites and the one with the least behind it,
and that asymmetry is stated on purpose. Falsifier: state the measurand, state the
units, measure two non-adjacent rungs with it.
NOT a ladder of consciousness, awareness, or mind. NA-10 records that reading
INADMISSIBLE: no measurand, no units, no instrument, no falsifier — and the one
structurally checkable property (the blanket) does not ascend with scale. Recorded,
not mocked: the intuition that the ladder points somewhere is honest and common. It
is simply not a measurement, and dressing it as one is the defect.
NOT that the sixteen rungs are the right sixteen. The carving is a choice; the
boundaries' physics is not.
NOT that Kleiber's 3/4 is a law of life. It is a metazoan-regime fit; prokaryotes
are superlinear at ~1.7 (NA10-21, NA10-24). NA-10 records the 3/4 exponent as the
single most over-extrapolated number in its wing.
NOT an optimum. Per Gould & Lewontin (1979), nothing here establishes that any
rung's arrangement is optimal; drift, phylogenetic inertia, developmental constraint
and frozen accidents produce structure that solves nothing. Nature's authority here
is precisely and only this: it already ran the experiment under real constraints,
with the failures deleted. Every value above is a hypothesis generator, never a proof.
NOT a UNI claim of any kind. A NATURE CITATION IS NEVER A UNI GATE: reading
Kleiber's law raises no UNI rung. This plate contains ZERO UNI claims, and the honest
program position is untouched by every value on it — ~2 of 11+ developmental rungs
earned; a developmental active-inference SIMULATION; a toy world, never a person.
QUAESTIO APERTA. "Full human" and "beyond human" appear nowhere here as a target,
a milestone, or a deliverable. They are permanent open questions. The scale ladder has
no top, no destination, and no rung labelled with either — and the temptation to read
one in at rung 10 or 11 is exactly what the NOT-MEASURED fence exists to refuse.
HONEST FENCE — MODELED. This plate is a placement model rendering NA-10,
itself fenced MODELED: it composes measured constants and published fits through
stated assumptions — that "characteristic length" is well-defined per rung; that one
force dominates per regime; that adopted IAU nominal constants (rungs 13–15) stand in
for measured values. They are exact BY ADOPTION, explicitly not current best estimates,
and must never be quoted as measurements with uncertainties. THE ASSUMPTIONS ARE THE
FENCE. Per M22 (the cavity principle) NA-10's placements are an upstream prior and this
plate must never be re-served as fresh evidence downstream.
